content.comment_body: Hello, Sorry if this is not the right place for this question. Is it possible to adjust PI settings, specifically KC and TI, using an HMI panel? I am aware that the parameters can be addressed via VM mapping, but what steps are needed at the HMI for this? I’ve successfully configured a weekly timer block through the HMI using hexadecimal for the timing parameters. Would I need to use a similar approach for the PI block? Any advice or practical examples would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.

Hi [user_name], I’ve created an example for you using [product_name], [product_name] [version_no], HMI panel, and [product_name] [version_no]. Values can be sent to the HMI using VM parameter mapping. One point to note is about the integration time: this value is in seconds. Internally, [product_name] converts this into a 'minutes:seconds' format for display, but the actual value passed is only in seconds. For instance, if TI is 2 minutes 30 seconds, the HMI displays 150 (as 2 x 60 + 30), instead of 2:30.
Thanks again, really appreciate your help.
Hi [user_name], Glad I could help. Have you managed to resolve your issue?

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discussed adjusting parameters of a PI block via a HMI panel. While parameter mapping from a controller to the HMI is possible, the integration time (TI) is only displayed in seconds by the HMI, even though internally on the controller it's shown as minutes and seconds. This can make the display less intuitive and may confuse users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to configure and view PI block values on the HMI in a clear and straightforward way. Ideally, the HMI should present data in the same format as the controller for ease of understanding.
